subject.facility_name: COLONIAL HEALTH & REHAB CENTER OF PLAINFIELD, LLC

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $183.59 per resident day (48.0% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 11.8% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $81,248, 1.4% of the $5,807,923 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,000,913, $31.64 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $476,056 (47.6%), allocated fringe $145,740 (14.6%), non-wage costs $379,117 (37.9%). Raw food was $346,928 ($10.97 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $367,536, $11.62 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $248,135 (67.5%), allocated fringe $75,964 (20.7%), non-wage costs $43,437 (11.8%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $136,902, $4.33 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $79,982 (58.4%), allocated fringe $24,486 (17.9%), non-wage costs $32,434 (23.7%).
Missing data: cost year 2015 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
